headline: The "PM Task" area covers 16 project-management and planning activities (project charter, project plan, schedules, kickoff and pre-planning meetings, infrastructure and CI/CD requests, facilities, open-source policy, configuration-management baseline), and none of them could be confirmed from the codebase because they are administrative steps carried out in external PM and governance tools rather than software to be built.
what_is_there: The code that was examined belongs to an AI agent application — task execution, provider integrations, security policy, monitoring and configuration — and contains nothing that represents project charters, project plans, resource allocation lists or procurement requests. Where a file matched on a word like "plan", "schedule" or "resource", it turned out to serve an unrelated in-app purpose.
what_is_unclear: Whether each of these activities actually happened cannot be judged from source code at all; the evidence for them lives in the external planning tool, approval records, meeting notes and CM reports, none of which were available to the analysis.
suggested_action: Track these tickets against records in the PM and governance tools (approvals, meeting minutes, request tickets) rather than expecting code evidence, and consider marking them as non-code items so future traceability reviews skip them.
